intro.text: This meal adds 50 fire damage for 30 seconds.

steps.skills: 4 x QL Ranged Energy and E-Beamer has to be 80% of the QL of the Wings

steps.text: Note: the Beamer must be one of these variations: #L "Premium E-Beamer" "122139" - #L "Quality E-Beamer" "122131" - #L "Balanced E-Beamer" "122134" - #L "Fine-Tuned E-Beamer" "122136" - #L "Deluxe E-Beamer" "122137" or #L "E-Beamer" "122129"
